author: Moises Taveras
description:
In the heart of Brooklyn, there is now a devastatingly gorgeous manga panel from Jiro Taniguchi's Ice Age: Chronicle of the Earth hung on a gallery wall. I can't tell you what it says--I fear my scant familiarity with Japanese doesn't extend to literacy in kanji--but I can tell you what it portrays: a cityscape consumed by nature. A lush tangle of vines and trees reclaiming the Earth from its disastrous, mettlesome inheritors. 

While I doubt this panel and manga are the first time this kind of image has cropped up, it certainly feels like a progenitor to many similar visuals across the years. Your mind might jump to I Am Legend, the Will Smith-led feature film about a post-apocalyptic New York City, for example. My mind jumped straight to Nier Automata's city that's been lost to time, as well as The Last of Us' many dilapidated small towns and US metropolises. Though I went into the Brooklyn Museum's new
title: Your Favorite Video Games Will Always Be Influenced By Manga

author: Scott White
description:
Behind his cheerful delivery and presentation, it turns out that Max Miller, known for turning historical recipes into entertaining yet educational YouTube lessons with his show Tasting History, is also quite serious about board games. Now, game designer Michael Shinall (Marvel Zombies, DCeased, and others) and publisher Salt Games are working with Max to bring him from his kitchen straight to your tabletop with a brand-new worker-placement game based on his popular series, which launched on Kickstarter this week. Recently, we had the chance to sit down with both Max and Michael to hear about how this new adaptation will play, a bit about how it all came to be, and why, whether you are coming at this as a fan of Tasting History or board games, there will be something on this plate you may like.

In Tasting History: Th
title: Max Miller’s Tasting History Is Coming To Your Tabletop With A New Board Game

author: Jade King
description:
It has been less than two years since Xbox announced that longtime series developer 343 Industries would be rebranding to Halo Studios. This was envisioned as a new dawn for the beloved shooter franchise, as Xbox seemed to leave the Reclaimer Trilogy behind as it sought to tighten Master Chief’s focus to enable a more faithful and satisfying future.

As someone who always held out hope for Halo regardless of how dire things seemed, I was legitimately convinced that this reformed studio was destined for bigger and brighter things. I became even more reassured following the July release of Campaign Evolved, a confident remake that despite polarising reception amongst hardcore audiences, did its job of pulling
title: The Halo We Grew Up With Is Never Coming Back

author: Chris Compendio
description:
Included in the shocking news of EA's restructuring, which includes layoffs and the closure of BioWare, is a mention from the publisher that Apex Legends studio Respawn Entertainment and Battlefield maker DICE are collaborating on a project. According to a report, that project is a long-awaited sequel set in a galaxy far, far away.

Per Variety, which cites "multiple sources," the DICE and Respawn project is Star Wars Battlefront 3. While EA itself did not confirm this, the
title: Star Wars Battlefront 3 Reportedly In Development By EA’s Top Shooter Studios

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Microsoft has revealed how much it will charge people for using the Xbox Cloud Gaming service without a Game Pass membership. Right now, this is available only to Xbox Insiders, but that's a free program that anyone can join.

Also notable is that the prices below are described as "introductory launch pricing," and that wording suggests the prices may change in the future. Microsoft is calling these "cloud playtime packs."
title: Xbox Cloud Gaming Hourly Prices Revealed For Non-Game Pass Members

author: Ben Janca
description: While developer King Art Games is billing Dawn of War IV as a modern interpretation of the first game, there are lessons from the second and third entries shaping it as well.
title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV Looks To Right The Wrongs Of Its Predecessor | Preview

author: S.E. Doster
description:
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 releases this week, and the campaign and DMZ are currently in early access. Infinity Ward delivers an epic series conclusion for its Modern Warfare reboot, but if you're finding some missions tough on a normal difficulty setting, don't worry–you're not alone.

Modern Warfare 4 features 16 missions in total, and these offer a wide variety of staple Call of Duty missi
title: Don’t Worry, You’re Not The Only One Dying Too Much In Modern Warfare 4’s Campaign

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
When EA was acquired by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund, many expected major changes at the gaming company, including layoffs and game cancellations, among other shakeups. Now, those have begun, with EA on October 21 confirming a series of significant changes impacting the people and teams that worked on many storied franchises.

EA also teased some of what's to come in the future, including a joint project between Respawn and DICE. Here's a rundown of all the big EA news today.

Layoffs

EA said in a
title: EA Cancels New Mass Effect, Pauses New Sims Game, And All The Other  Big EA News That Just Happened

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Rayman Legends Retold is almost here, and as you'd expect from this remake, it's a pretty noticeable graphical glow-up of Rayman Legends and it includes a very French outfit for you to dress the phantom-limbed hero and his partner Barbara up in. Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 fans, this is where you do the Leonardo DiCaprio pointing meme.

Even though Ubisoft doesn't mention Sandfall Interactive or Expedition 33 by name, it did confirm that the new baguette outfits are "a playful nod to a fellow game" created in Montpellier. "Conceived as a tribute from one French studio to another, these costumes celebrate the creativity, passion, and unmistakably French touch that continue to make the country's video game industry shine on the global stage," Ubisoft said in a press release. Sandfall Interactive is also headquartered in Montpellier.
title: Rayman Legends Retold’s New Baguette Costumes Are A Tip Of The Beret To Expedition 33

author: Levi Winslow
description:
I guess someone's gotta collect 'em all, and it appears that thieves are doing just that, as yet another high-stakes burglary in Southern California has resulted in just about $1 million worth of Pokemon cards being stolen from a FedEx truck.

According to a report by The New York Times' sports journalism department, The Athletic (via ABC News), a FedEx truck parked near the authenticating and grading business known as the Professional Sports Authenticator in Santa Ana, California, was robbed on October 13. The Santa Ana Police Department said in a statement to ABC News that hundreds of cards were stolen, with the robbery estimated at a value of $963,000.

"The pallets containe
title: Another Day, Another Pokemon Card Heist Worth Nearly $1 Million

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description: One of the most annoying things about PC games is how long they can take to start, thanks to the traditional shader compilation a game goes through after installation or after getting new drivers. The silver bullet to this might be Microsoft's Advanced Shader Delivery, which was used in Gears of War: E-Day to drastically cut down on its initial launch, and Nvidia graphics card owners can also take advantage of this technology starting today with the release of the version 621.01 drivers. AMD has featured this technology for a while now, but with Nvidia included, ASD will be open to the vast majority of the PC gaming community.
title: Nvidia Just Tackled One Of PC Gaming’s Biggest Headaches: Shader Compilation

author: Ben Janca
description:
The Edgerunners 2 Update is coming on October 22! Check out what’s new in this latest free update for Cyberpunk 2077.

Experience new content inspired by Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2, including a new quest set before the events of the anime. Go gung-ho with Dual Wielding, a new playstyle that doubles your firepower with dedicated perks. Customize your cyberware at glamdocs, discover community-made mods with Cross Platform Mod Support, take Night City Tours, and much, much more to discover.

The Edgerunners 2 Update will be available on October 22 on PC, Mac (Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store), PlayStation 5, XBOX Series X|S, and coming soon on Nintendo Switch 2 and Mac (Mac App Store version).
title: Cyberpunk 2077 | Edgerunners 2 Update Features Overview Trailer

author: Cameron Koch
description:
World of Warcraft: Forever will see players battling to become an ogre arena champion once more, this time in the new Riverglades zone.

Forever's launch is just a few weeks away on November 4, and every day it seems like Blizzard reveals new information about the game. In a new video titled "Your Leveling Journey Past 30," Blizzard goes into more detail about what to expect from the game's all-new Riverglades zone, diving into its Warcraft 2 lore roots and what players can expect to find there. The contested zone is divided up by multiple different factions, with the Brotherhood of the Horse representing the Alliance and the Boulder Rock ogre clan representing the Horde.

Blizzard makes a point to call out a new ogre arena in the trailer, deep within Boulder Rock
title: WoW: Forever Is Continuing A Long-Running Questing Tradition

author: Levi Winslow
description:
Publisher Electronic Arts is planning to shut down legendary RPG studio BioWare, laying off about 50 employees at the studio alongside 350 more elsewhere at EA.

In a new Bloomberg report, a person familiar with the matter said a total of 3% of EA's overall company has been affected by this latest round of layoffs.

According to a staff letter sent out on Wednesday that Bloomberg viewed, EA chief operating officer David Tinson and chief studios officer Cam
title: EA Shuts Down Dragon Age, Mass Effect Studio BioWare

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
New details about Rockstar's GTA 6 continue to come to light ahead of the highly anticipated crime game's release in November. Reporter Jason Schreier published a video recently in which he discussed some of the new things about GTA 6 that he learned when interviewing Rockstar, including how the game will feature the next evolution of fine details like the horse testicle system in Rockstar's last game, Red Dead Redemption II, along with information about the game's roads and "dark" years of development on the project.

One of the details is that GTA 6's roads are nar
title: GTA 6 Will Feature Lots Of Small Details Like Red Dead’s Dynamic Horse Testicle Physics

author: Levi Winslow
description:
Everyone wants to play Rockstar Games' upcoming heist-'em-up Grand Theft Auto 6--so much so that some 1.5 million Americans are projected to call in sick to work on November 19 to play the game, which an economics professor estimates will set the country back roughly $1 billion.

According to an International Business Times report, economics professor José García Montalvo projected that the 1.5 million workers planning to play hooky to traipse around Leonida next month could cost America a boatload of money. If each worker has an annual salary of $70,000, Montalvo suggests that the math works out to $1 billion, with GTA 6 publisher Take-Two Interactive estimated to make that same amount on November 19.
title: GTA 6 Might Give America A Very Expensive Sick Day

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
The world of Diablo will expand over the next couple of years with a new video game and a Netflix animated series, but if you'd rather roll some dice, Diablo Unbound will offer an officially licensed tour of Sanctuary when it launches.

The new board game is billed as a highly replayable co-op (or solo) action game that spans several genres and gameplay mechanics to create what developer Glass Cannon Unplugged calls a "dungeon battler" experience. It'll enter the Gamefound crowdfunding platform in Q1 2027, and as you'd expect from one of these campaigns, it will offer a range of stretch goals, exclusive
title: Diablo Is Getting A New Board Game, And You Can Play It Solo

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
A new season of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners is now on Netflix, and to celebrate, Cyberpunk 2077 is getting an update.  Developer CD Projekt Red announced Update 2.5 this week, teasing new items and features inspired by the anime spin-off's second season.

Beyond that, the studio is keeping mum on the biggest upgrades coming to Cyberpunk 2077 when the update goes live on October 22 for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S. Switch 2 players will get the update a few days later.

Since we're feeling impatient and ready to return to Night City, we'll track everything revealed in the dedicated livestream for Update 2.5. Refresh your page to see all the new stuff as it's announced.

While you're here, you can read more about Edgerunners Season 2
title: Everything New In Cyberpunk 2077 Update 2.5

author: Jason Fanelli
description:
New York Comic Con can be a strange place sometimes, but this year, Sega gave select media the opportunity to make it stranger (than heaven). We went hands-on with developer Ryu ga Gotoku's next major project, and while our extended look offered glimpses into the decades-spanning adventure, there's clearly still a lot more to see. 

The three-hour demo was broken up into five parts. The first three were all set in 1915, first on a ship headed to Japan, and then in the harbor town of Kokura. These three sections introduced key characters, a major conflict in protagonist Makoto's early life, and a climactic battle in an ironworks factory.
title: Stranger Than Heaven’s Story Is Built On “Fictional Realism”

author: Ben Janca
description: Ryu Ga Gotoku's next major game hopes to live up to Like A Dragon's legacy.
title: Stranger Than Heaven’s Story Is Built On “Fictional Realism” | Preview

author: Evan Campbell
description:
We just got our strongest hint at what Xbox Labs might be "cooking up" for players, thanks to Xbox chief technology officer Scott Van Vliet. The executive posted a video on X that ends with Halo 3 booting up inside what appears to be the Microsoft Edge web browser. In fact, the option to play the beloved FPS with mouse and keyboard even appears as a prompt, too.

Van Vliet noted that he was working on "retro vibes" in the social media post, and he also tagged Xbox CEO Asha Sharma. Intriguingly, neither executive notes Halo 3 booting up inside the browser; instead, they focus on the return of the Xbox Blades dashboard. That user interface from roughly two decades ago is a fan-favorite.
title: Halo 3 Looks Like It Could Come To Browsers Via Xbox Labs

author: Ben Janca
description:
That cure of life, shall whisper of poison.

The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother releases March 18, 2027 on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 and Steam. Pre-order now!

The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother is the first-ever console game adaptation of the popular franchise "The Apothecary Diaries", featuring a brand-new story conceptualized by series author Hyuganatsu.

Two chains of strange phenomenon and conspiracies are causing chaos throughout the rear palace, red-light district, and streets of the capital. Apothecary Maomao must use every ounce of her intelligence and knowledge to solve the mysteries and unveil the truth behind the False Imperial Brother before it destroys the imperial court.
title: The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother – Gameplay Reveal Trailer

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Another day, another PS5 update, as Sony tweaks its system with another minor upgrade. It looks like business as usual for PS5 Update Version: 26.07-14.20.00, with Sony focusing on overall usage and message readability, but there are murmurs that the patch could also be quietly plugging a few jailbreak holes.

First, the actual update. "We've improved the messages and usability on some screens," Sony's succinct patch notes read.

For your average PS5 user, this won't mean much and downloading the new firmware is just part of the process before you can start playing a game. But people in the homebrew and PS5 jailbreaking scene will likely avoid an update just in case Sony fixes a vulnerability that pirates and modders have taken full advantage of. Recently, hackers released the "Relapse" exploit,
title: New PS5 Update Is Out Now, And Sony May Be Tightening Security Before GTA 6

description:
From new stories, ocean exploration, and more content to enrich your life in Pywel, get a closer look at what new adventures await in Crimson Desert Enhanced's DLC Charting the Unknown with this Features Overview video.

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
EA Sports has announced that its Fight Night series of boxing games is coming back. Fans have been waiting a very long time, considering the last game in the series was 2011's Fight Night Champion for PS3 and Xbox 360.

The franchise debuted in 2004 with Fight Night 2004, and sequels were released in 2005, 2006, and 2009 before Champion came out in 2011.

"To everyone who stayed in our corner: Fight Night is coming back," EA Sports said.

Beyond the statement and the teaser art, there is nothing more to go on, so we don't yet know when the game might release or what new features it could have.

While Fight Night has been dorman
title: After 15-Year Absence, EA Is Bringing Back The Fight Night Franchise

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Xbox CEO Asha Sharma is reportedly plotting a "major overhaul" of the Xbox Game Pass service, beyond some of the big changes she's made already like dropping new Call of Duty game releases from the membership.

According to Fortune, Xbox could overhaul Game Pass to give players the ability to choose features à la carte. This would reportedly include things like cloud gaming, multiplayer, and "add-ons for console-only games." Game Pass would evolve to operate on a "tiered structure," the report said.

This reporting follows on from another Game Pass rumor in September that claimed Microsoft would
title: Xbox Game Pass Heading For A Massive Shakeup, Report Says

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Everything has a selling price, and in Xbox's case, Microsoft's gaming division could be worth at least $100 billion. That's according to a new report, which claims that several private equity firms mulled purchasing Xbox and were willing to go as high as $150 billion for Microsoft's gaming hub--enough cash to buy 15 billion rubber duckies, 50 billion McDouble Cheeseburgers, or 100 billion Costco Hot Dog combos. Or if you felt like wasting that cash, you could easily fund the production of 500 more Avatar movies from James Cameron.

According to The Information, the companies involved were merely exploring options and didn't start any negotiations with Microsoft. Fortune recently claimed that seve
title: Prospective Buyers Reportedly Value Xbox As High As $150 Billion

author: Dave Irwin
description:
Out of all the bosses in Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, only the Brittle King is truly optional. There is a tasty reward at the end of it in the form of Excalibur, the greatsword of Arthurian Legend and one of the most powerful weapons in the game, but that and the Brittle King's Arcana powers are the only tangible rewards for this side endeavor.

And he doesn't exactly make it easy to fight him in the first place. His chambers are in Notre Dame, close to one of the Sage's Sigils, but as you enter the boss room, you'll discover Excalibur wedged in stone with a plaque hinting at what you need to do to rip it out. Luckily, by this point in the metroidvania game, you should have everything you need to pass his test.
title: How To Pass The Brittle King’s Test

author: Dave Irwin
description:
Getting all four Virtues in Castlevania: Belmont's Curse to unlock the path to the best ending is no mean feat, and the trickiest required Arcana to get is by far the Sage. To get it, you need to free Eleanor of Acquitane from her mirror prison. Clues hidden around the castle reveal that these save point mirrors act as a pocket dimension, but there are a handful that have sigils on them.

There are two reasons for this. Some save points are hidden in really hard-to-reach areas, while others are in places that can be easily overlooked and cumbersome to find later on. On top of that, your job is not yet over once you break all four Sigils. So if you want the best ending
title: How To Break The Sage Sigils In Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse

author: Dave Irwin
description:
Early in Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, the Ferryman notices that some of his coins are missing. These are vital to the souls trying to move on to the afterlife, as you need to pay the Ferryman to let you cross, but without coins, they have nowhere to go. As it turns out, one of the Parisian bishops has absconded with the money, having become corrupted by Dracula's influence.

These three cursed Relics count toward the 26 total, but they don't really do anything on their own. Instead, you need to equip all three to open the way to the Miser's boss fight. Here are the locations of his lair, as well as all three Miser eye puzzle rooms. If
title: Where To Find The Miser’s Three “Eyes” Relics In Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
The furore over Sony's decision to effectively kill physical games on its PlayStation platform appears to have died down (for now), and new data from Alinea Analytics shows how wide the split between physical and digital PS5 games is in 2026. As Alinea's head of market analysis, Rhys Elliott, notes, PlayStation's top new 2026 games by physical copies are mostly single-player AAA titles, with Resident Evil Requiem the best-seller.

C
title: PS5’s Biggest Physical Games Look Very Different From Its Biggest Digital Hits

author: Tom Caswell
description:
Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV is arriving nearly a decade after the release of the third game in the real-time strategy series, and after spending some time with an extensive preview build that covered the opening missions of two its campaigns, I’m happy to report that it seems to be a return to form after the ill-received changes in Dawn of War III.

The Dawn of War series has always reinvented itself with each entry. Dawn of War II eschewed the first game’s focus on amassing large armies in favor of micro-managing smaller groups, or sometimes individual units. It removed the original's base-building mechanics, and its maps were less of an open-ended sandbox, hewing closer to being an isometric action-RPG. While these changes didn’t sit well with some players of the original Dawn of War, others found the alterations to be bold,
title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV Looks To Right The Wrongs Of Its Predecessor

author: Callum Self
description:
The mark of a masterpiece expansion is that it becomes an essential part of the playthrough. Cyberpunk 2077’s Phantom Liberty, The Witcher 3’s Blood and Wine, and Skyrim’s Dragonborn are some examples. Dark Arisen for Dragon’s Dogma 2 will be treated the same as those legendary DLCs I mentioned, and right now, you can get the entire experience at a great price.

For those unaware and currently missing out on one of the best RPGs in recent years, Dragon’s Dogma 2 puts you in the starring role as your own Arisen--a character whose heart has been eaten by a dragon and who is destined to defeat it. Sadly, someone else has taken the role of Arisen as a false leader, meaning you and your party (a main Pawn and some stragglers you hire from the Rift) have to deal with a variety of issues. That means
title: The Full Dragon’s Dogma 2 Experience Is Cheaper Than Ever, So Eat Your Heart Out
